title: Publish release notes
instruction: Create the GitHub release for the new tag with `gh release create v<version> --title "v<version>" --notes-file <file>`, the notes being the changelog section for this version plus a one-line upgrade note when the release has a breaking change. Use `--draft` when the run's arguments say draft. No attribution footer or generated-by line. Print the release URL, then mark the Kata run finished in the state file.
